summary: Iteration 3 focused on the hero redesign + regression of all flows. Backend regression: 17/17 pytest tests PASS (auth, products/categories, wallet topup/purchase/insufficient/transactions). GET /api/products returns 6 products all with category + unique Unsplash image_url; Pack Growth Pro image_url is distinct (photo-1522125670776...) from the other 5. Frontend: home loads with hero-image visible (real Unsplash woman photo photo-1712431922265-cc87f466a63b), floating badges (+1.240 likes / +380 seguidores / 24.5k views / En tendencia / @sofi.creator card) render, stats (12k+/2 clics/24-7) and hero CTAs work — 'Ver paquetes' navigates to /productos, 'Cargar saldo' navigates to /cargar-saldo. featured-grid, how-it-works and testimonials-section all visible without page-error. On /productos: search 'TikTok' -> 2 paquetes, clear-search resets to 6, category-chip-Instagram -> 2, no-products state appears with 'zzzznoresultxxx'. Registered new user -> $0.00 shown in header-balance. TopUp /cargar-saldo: method-card + quick-50 + topup-submit-btn -> redirected to /mi-cuenta, account-balance $50.00, transactions-list visible. Purchase 500 Likes Instagram ($5) -> success toast 'Compraste... Nuevo saldo' -> header-balance $45.00. Purchase Pack Growth Pro ($99) with $45 balance -> shows 'Saldo insuficiente. Carga saldo para completar tu compra' toast with 'Cargar saldo' action button. Admin login (admin@inflowmkt.com / InflowAdmin2026) shows nav-admin. Mobile viewport 430x900: mobile-menu-toggle visible on home and /productos; no horizontal overflow on either page (scrollWidth==clientWidth==430). No console page errors observed during redesigned flows.

issues: results-count momentarily reads '0 paquetes' before /api/products resolves — consider a small skeleton/loader or hide the counter until data is ready.

action_items: (Optional UX) Show loading state instead of '0 paquetes' while /api/products is in flight.
(Carryover) CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid; app uses Bearer tokens so allow_credentials can be False, or set explicit origins.
(Carryover) storage put_object/get_object use blocking requests inside async handlers — consider httpx.AsyncClient / run_in_threadpool.
(Carryover) admin form has no dropdown/autocomplete for existing categories — risk of typos/fragmentation.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero image is a hardcoded Unsplash URL in Home.js — if Unsplash CDN blocks or changes the asset, hero silently breaks. Consider self-hosting the asset in /public or through the /api/files upload channel.
Home.js references framer-motion for badges — ensure it's declared in package.json (verified working, but no fallback if bundle fails).
results-count renders '0 paquetes' pre-fetch (see minor UX above).
Purchase still uses $inc without a conditional balance guard; concurrent double-click could still race. For MVP acceptable.
test_credentials: Admin admin@inflowmkt.com / InflowAdmin2026 verified. Users registered dynamically with Test1234.
seed_data_creation: Uses existing seed of 6 social products. Registered ephemeral users test_<rand>@inflow.com for topup/purchase flows.
